phase_prompt.label: Phase 1: The Collision
phase_prompt.summary: The stars are newly bound, a chaotic collision of black geometry and wild, venting plasma. The binding fields are active and violent.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Cinematic close-up of seven obsidian asteroids crashing into each other in a black void. Sparks of white hot data fly from the impact zones. The structures are wrapped in violent, shimmering heat waves. Intense blue and violet plasma erupts from cracks. The scene is chaotic and high-energy. Hyper-realistic, 8k, dramatic lighting.
